summary:
Reproduction of "Interpreting Emergent Planning in Model-Free RL" (ICLR 2025 Oral).

## What was reproduced:

### Environment (Section 2.2, Appendix E.2)
- Full Sokoban environment: 8×8 grid, symbolic 7-channel observations, correct transition dynamics (box pushing, wall collisions), reward structure (-0.01/step, +1 box on target, -1 box off target, +10 solve), random episode lengths [115,120]

### DRC Agent Architecture (Section 2.3, Appendix E.3)
- DRC(D,N) with configurable D layers and N internal ticks (default DRC(3,3))
- ConvLSTM cells with 32 channels, kernel size 3, zero padding
- Bottom-up skip connections (i_t to all layers)
- Top-down skip connections (final layer output to bottom layer on next tick)
- Pool-and-Inject mechanism (mean+max spatial pooling with affine transform)
- Actor-critic with policy and value heads
- DRC(1,9) and DRC(9,1) variants supported (Appendix F)
- ResNet agent with 24 residual blocks (Appendix G)

### Probing Methodology (Section 4, Appendix D)
- 1×1, 3×3, 5×5, 7×7 spatial linear probes
- C_A (Agent Approach Direction) and C_B (Box Push Direction) concepts: 5 classes {NEVER, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT}
- Behavioral-dependent concept labeling from episode trajectories
- Binary simplifications and reversed asymmetrical concepts (Appendix D.4)
- Global probes for future action prediction (Appendix D.5)
- AdamW training, cross-entropy loss, macro F1 evaluation
- Probe vector extraction for interventions

### Plan Formation Analysis (Section 5, Appendix A)
- Test-time plan refinement measurement during "thinking steps"
- Multi-layer plan decoding
- Corridor length experiments (Appendix A.3.2)
- Evidence of iterative search behavior

### Intervention Experiments (Section 6, Appendix B)
- Agent-Shortcut interventions (Algorithm 1)
- Box-Shortcut interventions (Algorithm 2)
- Cutoff level interventions (Appendix B.3)
- g'_{x,y} = g_{x,y} + α·w_k mechanism
- Short-route (NEVER) and directional components
- Variable α and p parameters (Appendix B.2)
- Random probe baseline comparison

### Training & Emergence Analysis (Section 6.2, Appendix C)
- IMPALA-based training (γ=0.97, λ=0.97)
- L2 penalties, entropy regularization
- Checkpoint-based emergence tracking
- Correlation analysis between concept F1 and planning behavior

### Visualization Suite
- Internal plan visualization (teal/purple arrows)
- Probe performance bar charts (Figure 4)
- Test-time refinement plots (Figure 6)
- Emergence correlation plots (Figure 9)
- Intervention effect visualizations (Figures 7, 8)

## Key Assumptions
- Agent weights require actual training (250M transitions on Boxoban)
- Boxoban dataset must be downloaded separately
- Exact handcrafted level layouts for interventions are representative implementations
